isolated_trailing_arabic_characters.root_cause_hypothesis: The English article-marker y-coordinate is used as the extraction end boundary. On the Arabic column, the next marker line begins about 1.83 points above that boundary and extends about 10.48 points below it. The clip therefore intersects the next Arabic marker; subsequent extraction/cleanup leaves an isolated fragment. For Article 1122, the lone ل is associated with the intervening Arabic heading/marker layout rather than the legal sentence.
